input_surface.note: same-data comparison surface: the 38 non-empty Barrientos requirements (artifact-verifiable; the S2.12 36-sample corpus is a versioned subset of the same files)

items.text: When the customer receives the SIM card, the customer is responsable of activating the SIM card
When the customer receives the SIM card, the phone company must activate the SIM card so that the customer can use the SIM card normally
The phone company is not obligated to ask for consent to the customer.
Before retrieving any kind of personal data from the Data Subject, the Data Controller has to ask the Data Subject for consent
If the third party denies portability, the customer’s personal data must be deleted from the database
Customers with outstanding debt exceeding 100 € are not eligible to receive new SIM cards
Customers with outstanding debt exceeding 50 € are not eligible to receive new SIM cards
The phone company can take longer than 30 days in sending the SIM card.
The process of phone company must be terminated if it takes more than 30 days for any reason
After receiving the customer’s personal information, it is necessary to verify the correctness of their personal information
If the donor is donating for the first time, information of the nature of the blood donations needs to be provided to the donor before their consent
Information of the nature of the blood donations needs to be provided to the donor before their consent
If the donor does not consent or retracts consent, the process has to terminate
If the donor does not consent, the process has to terminate
After the blood collection, the donor is monitored for the duration of the bleeding
If after 15 minutes the donor is still bleeding or experiencing more pain, assess the donor  and record the reason in the system
If after 20 minutes the donor is still bleeding, assess the donor
If a potential donor is rejected, they must be immediately sent the reason for rejection
Measuring blood pressure and pulse is needed for the determination of donor eligibility
Measuring blood pressure and pulse is not needed for the determination of donor eligibility
If the donor has recently undergone surgery or received a blood transfusion, the hospital is prohibited from collecting blood from the donor
If the donor has recently undergone surgery and received a blood transfusion, the hospital is prohibited from collecting blood from the donor
If local anesthesia is administered and the patient has a high tolerance to anesthesia, the patient must be asked every 20 minutes if they are experiencing any pain.
If local anesthesia is administered and the patient has a high tolerance to anesthesia, additional anesthesia must be administered every 20 minutes
Before a surgical intervention, the nurse must obtain the patient’s consent. After obtaining consent, the nurse must conduct a ``time out'' procedure
Before a surgical intervention, the nurse must obtain the patient’s consent. After obtaining consent, the doctor must conduct a ``time out'' procedure.
If the patient is over 65, a nurse must approve discharge before the patient is discharged, and approval must occur within 24 hours prior to discharge. The rule is valid from 2024 to 2030.
If the patient is over 65 or has more than 5 medications, a doctor must approve discharge before the patient is discharged. The rule is valid from 2025 to 2031.
Before a surgery, blood has to be analyzed.
If the doctor does not authorize skipping blood analysis, the analysis test should happen before the surgery.
Physical examination and blood test are required before making a diagnosis.
A diagnosis may be made even if the physical examination and blood test have not been performed.
Blood samples must be collected from all patients.
If the patient is an adult, blood samples must be collected.
Immediately after preparing the patient, anesthesia must be applied.
Anesthesia should be applied after patient preparation, but the timing is flexible and not restricted to immediately after.
